items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 63:1
items.html: The ascent of Malchut means the ascent of the screen, after its refinement from all the coarseness of the body within it, to the screen of the Rosh of Yeshsut, on which a new coupling is made at the stature of phase one, and only the phase from below upward came out in it, and this is what corrected the posteriors of Yeshsut in lines and completed the correction of lines in all of VAK. (p. 569, Sub Header, “For”)
